title: Signalling, Control-Command & Communications

canonicalTerminology.definition: A movement authority is permission for a train to proceed to a defined location under specified conditions within the applicable train-control system.

claims.text: Signalling and train-control systems manage safe train separation and movement through controlled information, detection, interlocking and onboard or trackside functions.
claims.applicabilityNote: Educational canonical statement. Apply current controlled legislation, infrastructure-manager rules and approved system documentation for operational use.

visualSpecs.purpose: Show high-level information flow without implementation-specific safety logic.

prohibitedUnsupportedClaims: Do not invent braking curves, separation distances, signal aspects or operational thresholds.
Do not present educational diagrams or summaries as approved signalling or operating instructions.
